newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker EPS view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it reduced its earnings estimates for Brinker International Inc to $0.89 a share, down from $0.94, for fiscal 1997 ending in June and to $1.12 a share, down from $1.15, for fiscal 1998.
-- EVEREN said the company continues to experience higher than expected food costs due to commodity pricing and the rollout of a new menu. Higher than expected labor costs also are expected.
-- It continues to rate Brinker outperform.
